verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a SaaS service for company formation and compliance, so programmatic or headless automation is a fair axis for it. The evidence, however, shows only a dashboard and in-app workflows. The lone pricing-page line "Advanced API integrations" is an undefined bookkeeping feature, not a documented headless or CI interface. The OpenAPI and llms.txt probes all returned 404, so there is no evidence of an API, CLI or other automatable entry point.
